candidates.refactoringInfo: Move method validateContent to class MailInterceptor
candidates.description:
Move method validateContent to net.myvietnam.mvncore.interceptor.MailInterceptor
Rationale: The validateContent() method is designed to validate content, which aligns closely with the purpose of the MailInterceptor, as it is responsible for intercepting and validating email content. Moving this method to MailInterceptor would enhance the cohesion of the class, ensuring that all email-related validation logic is encapsulated within the MailInterceptor. This separation of concerns is crucial for maintainability and clarity in the codebase.

candidates.refactoringInfo: Move method createWatchMessageBean to class WatchMail
candidates.description:
Move method createWatchMessageBean to com.mvnforum.user.WatchMail
Rationale: The method createWatchMessageBean() is primarily concerned with creating a watch message for a user based on the threads they are watching. This directly relates to the WatchMail class, which is responsible for managing the watch mail functionality, including the list of threads being watched (m_threadWatchList) and the associated member information. Moving this method to WatchMail aligns with the Single Responsibility Principle, as it centralizes the logic for creating watch messages within the class that manages watch mail. Additionally, the method utilizes several properties and methods of the WatchMail class, such as m_permission, m_dateFormat, and m_watchMailService, making it a natural fit for this class.
